title: 12-name watchlist · 08 Nov 2026 (Sun) · 04:00 SGT
summary: No distinct new company development was verified in this incremental window. Berkshire’s earlier Saturday earnings and previously covered technology stories were excluded as duplicates. All 12 November 6 regular-session closes and 72 adjusted-close baselines were freshly verified and remain unchanged. Friday prices predate the Saturday Berkshire earnings release; no earnings-related price reaction is claimed.
coverage_note: Fixed cutoff: 8 November 04:00 SGT (7 November 20:00 UTC). Incremental window: 7 November 23:30 SGT to 8 November 04:00 SGT, including a 30-minute overlap with the preceding 00:00 SGT edition. Reuters-oriented searches covered all 12 names. Seven issuer listings and eleven SEC archive directories were readable; Meta’s listing did not populate. Compared all 26 retained editions and 129 prior research records by events and source URLs. Coverage remains partial; no verified update does not establish that no news occurred.
price_basis: USD regular-session closes for 6 Nov 2026, the latest completed US session at cutoff. Fresh Yahoo Finance daily series and regularMarketTime metadata retrieved 7 Nov 20:00:01–20:00:03 UTC verify all 12 closes; the source verification completed at 20:00:47 UTC and independent raw-series arithmetic checks followed. Exact vendor quote timestamps are 6 Nov 21:00:00–21:00:02 UTC for eleven names and 21:03:23 UTC for BRK.B, each matching the completed daily bar. Daily changes compare Nov 6 with Nov 5 ordinary closes. Adjusted closes are separate cumulative-return endpoints. Daily-bar timestamps label sessions and are not substituted quote times. Postmarket observations are excluded. TSM is the US-listed USD ADR. Prices are saved observations, not live.
return_basis: Six cumulative 1–6 month returns use Yahoo adjusted closes reflecting vendor split and dividend/distribution adjustments. Formula: (endpoint adjusted close / baseline adjusted close - 1) x 100. Source values are rounded to cents before independent Decimal arithmetic; percentages round to two decimals. Baselines are the latest available sessions on or before each monthly anniversary: 6 Oct, 4 Sep, 6 Aug, 6 Jul, 5 Jun and 6 May 2026. Returns are not annualised and exclude investor fees, tax and FX. No independent reconstruction of dividend-adjustment factors or reinvestment model is claimed.
caveats: Reuters coverage uses partial search-index text, not an exhaustive live-wire feed. The prior direct Reuters HTTP 401 restriction was respected. Retrieval times do not replace original publication times.

Microsoft/Micron direct issuer and Amazon SEC restrictions, the earlier Broadcom issuer failure, Alphabet issuer unavailability and Meta’s incomplete listing rendering limit coverage. Seven readable issuer listings are not comprehensive company-news feeds.

Eleven readable SEC archive directories displayed latest modification dates November 6 or earlier. Directory modification metadata is not a filing acceptance timestamp. EDGAR browse pages were unpopulated shells, and no exhaustive statement about filings accepted in the incremental window is made.

Berkshire’s November 7 results were already included in the 16:00 UTC edition. Reuters indexed original publication time was 13:16:58 UTC, before this incremental window; later syndication updates are not treated as a new event.

A secondary article timestamped 17:01 UTC November 7 about the Magnificent Seven and an OKX-ICE venue described a November 5 notice. An original issuer or SEC document was not verified, so this retelling was excluded rather than promoted into new research.

No distinct new narrative research was verified. Empty research arrays preserve earlier reports and do not imply no news or a changed bullish or bearish view. Prior risks and catalysts remain available in dated reports; none are invented to fill this edition.

Prices and baselines use Yahoo Finance without independent cross-vendor corroboration. Vendor split/dividend adjustments and reinvestment conventions are not independently reconstructed. Cents-first Decimal arithmetic is reproducible from displayed values and may differ slightly from unrounded calculations.
